description: Checks for operational, security, privacy, and release-readiness gaps.

requirements.title: Frontend deployment verification
requirements.description: The public frontend deployment is reachable and serves the intended build.
requirements.why_it_matters: A deployment link is the starting point for a successful demonstration.
requirements.consequence: Users may be unable to access the application.
requirements.action: Open the public deployment in a clean browser session and test the primary user flow.
requirements.impact_rationale: the public application must be reachable for the demonstration

requirements.title: Database connection configuration
requirements.description: The production application can connect to the intended database with valid configuration.
requirements.why_it_matters: Core features cannot read or store data without a working connection.
requirements.consequence: The application can fail at runtime when it accesses data.
requirements.action: Verify the production connection from the deployed application and record the configuration owner.
requirements.impact_rationale: attendance and user features depend on database availability
negative_evidence: have not configured the database connection

requirements.title: Environment variables and secrets
requirements.description: Production configuration and credentials are stored securely outside source code.
requirements.why_it_matters: Missing configuration can break the release; exposed credentials create security risk.
requirements.consequence: The application may fail to start or secrets may be leaked.
requirements.action: Verify production environment variables, rotate exposed secrets, and keep them out of Git.
requirements.impact_rationale: credentials and production configuration can expose or disrupt the service

requirements.title: Source control and release version
requirements.description: The release source and a known-good version are stored in version control.
requirements.why_it_matters: A traceable version supports recovery and handover.
requirements.consequence: The team may not be able to identify or restore the demonstrated build.
requirements.action: Push the current release to GitHub and tag or record the demonstrated commit.
requirements.impact_rationale: a recoverable source version supports release recovery
negative_evidence: have not created a github repository

requirements.title: Load, concurrency, and database-capacity testing
requirements.description: The application and its database have been tested at the expected concurrent-user level, including connection limits and availability.
requirements.why_it_matters: A demonstration to many users can overload the application or exhaust database connections even when small manual tests pass.
requirements.consequence: Users may experience timeouts, failed logins, or unavailable attendance features.
requirements.action: Run a focused load test near 150 concurrent users, observe response times and errors, verify database connection-pool capacity and availability, and document capacity limits.
requirements.impact_rationale: service or database-capacity failure can prevent a large group from using the application
negative_evidence: not tested the application with many simultaneous users
database connection limits are not tested

requirements.title: Database backup and restoration verification
requirements.description: A backup exists and its restoration process has been tested.
requirements.why_it_matters: Attendance records and student data need a recoverable copy before a deployment failure.
requirements.consequence: Student records may be lost or unavailable after a failure.
requirements.action: Create a backup, restore it into a safe test database, and document the recovery owner and steps.
requirements.impact_rationale: this safeguard protects student records from permanent data loss
negative_evidence: haven't checked whether database backups are working
have not checked whether database backups are working

requirements.title: Authentication and role-based authorization testing
requirements.description: Each user role is tested against protected actions and records.
requirements.why_it_matters: A working login does not prove that students, faculty, and administrators have only permitted access.
requirements.consequence: Users could view or change records outside their role.
requirements.action: Test every role against protected pages and API actions, including attempted unauthorized access.
requirements.impact_rationale: incorrect permissions can expose or alter student records
negative_evidence: haven't checked whether all user roles have the correct permissions
have not checked whether all user roles have the correct permissions

requirements.title: Privacy and protection of student records
requirements.description: Student names, roll numbers, and attendance data are protected with least-privilege access and safe handling.
requirements.why_it_matters: Student records are personal information and require deliberate privacy safeguards.
requirements.consequence: Personal data could be exposed, shared incorrectly, or accessed by unauthorized users.
requirements.action: Review data access by role, minimize demo data, avoid exposing credentials or records in screenshots, and document data handling.
requirements.impact_rationale: the plan contains personally identifiable student records

requirements.title: Server restart and recovery testing
requirements.description: The deployed service recovers correctly after a server or process restart.
requirements.why_it_matters: A restart can reveal missing startup configuration, migrations, or connection recovery issues.
requirements.consequence: The application may remain unavailable after a routine restart.
requirements.action: Restart the production-like service, confirm health checks pass, and test sign-in and attendance marking afterward.
requirements.impact_rationale: a restart failure can make the service unavailable during the demonstration
negative_evidence: haven't checked whether the application recovers properly after a server restart
have not checked whether the application recovers properly after a server restart
not tested after a server restart

requirements.title: Rollback and deployment recovery planning
requirements.description: A failed release can be reverted safely to a known-good version.
requirements.why_it_matters: A recovery plan limits downtime when a deployment causes failures.
requirements.consequence: A faulty release may remain live with no clear recovery path.
requirements.action: Document the previous version, rollback steps, decision owner, and database-change recovery plan.
requirements.impact_rationale: a failed deployment needs a controlled way to restore service
negative_evidence: have not prepared a rollback plan

requirements.title: HTTPS and secure session configuration
requirements.description: The deployment uses HTTPS and secure session or cookie settings.
requirements.why_it_matters: Login credentials and student records need protection while moving between browsers and the service.
requirements.consequence: Sensitive data or authenticated sessions could be exposed in transit.
requirements.action: Enable HTTPS, redirect HTTP traffic, and set secure, HttpOnly, and appropriate SameSite session-cookie options.
requirements.impact_rationale: credentials and student records require secure transport and sessions

requirements.title: Error logging and monitoring
requirements.description: Errors and key service health signals can be observed after launch.
requirements.why_it_matters: Without visibility, failures can persist unnoticed during the demonstration.
requirements.consequence: Users may encounter outages without a fast diagnosis.
requirements.action: Enable structured error logging and define a simple health check or uptime alert.
requirements.impact_rationale: unobserved failures delay recovery during a live demonstration

requirements.title: Test coverage and input validation
requirements.description: Critical flows, invalid inputs, and deployment-specific behavior are covered beyond a small manual test.
requirements.why_it_matters: A feature working for a few users does not establish handling for invalid inputs or release conditions.
requirements.consequence: Unexpected inputs or untested paths may cause failures or corrupt records.
requirements.action: Add a smoke-test checklist and tests for invalid attendance data, permissions, and key database operations.
requirements.impact_rationale: insufficient coverage can expose unhandled errors in the core workflow
